scope: L2 THRESHOLD overfit on real bugs A--F under MODELLED OTA noise
real: A--F base crash dumps + the L2 comparator
validates: the THRESHOLD ONLY (the L2 weights are FIXED + literature-grounded -- their audit is in rdd/l2.py)
held_out: none -- A--F is the entire real bug set; Youden is fit-on-A--F (supporting evidence, not a generalization proof)
conclusion: NOT overfit [to A--F under the MODELLED OTA-noise regime; the threshold is noise-regime dependent per rdd/l2.py -- a deployment recalibrates]: AUC 0.993; the FIXED default 0.5 is ~the (fit-on-A--F, not held-out) Youden-J optimum 0.529, on a flat balanced-accuracy plateau [0.45,0.80] (~0.965); stable across 5 variation seeds (AUC 0.992-0.994, and 0.5 is on the plateau in ALL seeds); the band 0.05 is conservative (far below the same-bug floor 0.37).
